understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments using directional actions. Adjacent blocks may be pushed, while walls and boundaries can block movement; blocked hints are heuristic and actions may need testing. CLICK switches control to a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, allowing multiple pieces to be positioned independently.
